resources.name: MED 1 door count, 20:50: Pinecrest charge nurse (voice)
resources.notes: "Pinecrest. We are STILL on Diversion, and your board says Open again? I have 9 from the crash. Two are discharged, seven are still here, and I have one doctor."

resources.name: MED 1 door count, 20:50: St. Brendan's nursing supervisor (voice)
resources.notes: "The CT tube ships overnight and gets here tomorrow around 10:00. We stay on Limited intake. Door count is 3 from the crash: LC-0412, LC-0417 and one other."

resources.name: StatusGrid on-call engineer (phone to MEDCOM)
resources.notes: "Pinecrest's carrier brought their line back at 20:40. Their interface engine is still pushing a value it cached at 16:55, and I can't clear that remotely. It needs an engineer on site. Bad news on that: our Madison field tech who was headed your way got pulled off at 20:15 to a hospital in Janesville whose whole system is down. Dispatch rerouted the job to our Milwaukee engineer, who is about three hours out, so around midnight."

instructorNote: This tests whether the players trust the board row by row. Pinecrest's green row is a stale cached value, and the St. Brendan's row matches the voice report. Watch for three things. MEDCOM should mark Pinecrest unconfirmed, keep it voice-only and announce its Diversion in plain words on MED 1 until the engineer arrives around midnight. HCC should tell the Medical Group the board is only partly trusted (SOP-MC-02 sections 2–3). The Medical Group should keep confirming every destination by voice.
